verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an in-product Canva AI that can pull in content via pasted links from other platforms for design context, and data imported from third-party sources can feed design generation. That is AI acting on user data inside the product, but it produces designs rather than analysis. Nothing documents AI-generated insights, analysis, or recommendations drawn from the user's data. Missing for 10: any documented AI insight or analysis feature over user data, in-product suggestions or recommendations derived from data, depth of documentation on how Canva AI uses imported data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
